## Release Notes

### Node & Handler Governance
- **#1903**: Node-home ratchet refuses new ONEX nodes outside omnimarket; rejects baseline growth, stale entries, and new `onex.nodes` entry points.
- **#1428**: Canonical handler-shape ratchet-gate (Definition B). WARN-only on frozen baseline (6/8 core nodes); HARD-FAIL new non-canonical nodes or baseline growth. New nodes must be born canonical. 3-part adequacy+equivalence-gated flip for baselined nodes.
- **#1122**: `onex run` registered as canonical alias for `onex node`; identical flags and execution path.
- **#1068**: `WORKTREE_GUARD` bit (bit 59) added to `EnumHookBit`, replacing `ONEX_WORKTREE_GUARD` env var with `ONEX_HOOKS_MASK`.

### Context & Schema Models
- **#1130**: `ModelContextChunk`, `ModelContextPack` (frozen, `extra=forbid`), enums `EnumContextFactor`, `EnumContextPackProvenance`, `EnumContextPackFailure`; deterministic `compute_chunk_id()` via `ctx_` + sha256(factor:content)[:8].
- **#1144**: Antipattern Registry models: `ModelAntipatternExample`, `ModelAntipatternEntry` (validator: `pattern_type=semantic` requires `vector_enabled=True`), `ModelAntipatternRegistry`; all frozen, `from_attributes=True`.
- **#1084**: Kafka topics registered in `TopicBase`: `NODE_GENERATION_REQUESTED` (cmd), `NODE_GENERATION_COMPLETED`/`FAILED` (evt) per `onex.{cmd|evt}.omnimarket.{event-name}.v1`.

### Protocol & Verification
- **#53**: `ProtocolPackageVerifier` interface with `LiteralHashAlgorithm` (SHA256 v1), `verify_integrity()` (lowercase hex), `verify_signature()` (Ed25519 raw bytes), `compute_hash()`.
- **#341**: Pinned omnibase_core canonical-file-shape hook to rev with temp-file blob read fix (PR 1868, 300 s ceiling); avoids `git cat-file --batch` stdin pipe stall.

### Delegation & Routing
- **#3594**: Delegate-skill terminal stores `routing_tier`/`cost_tier_name` from accepting attempt or last rung reached; survives re-emit.
- **#2913**: Spread placement mode adds backend to rung's first-choice group; routing reducer picks member via stable hash of correlation ID.
- **#2902**: Delegation orchestrator declares typed `state_machine` loaded by `ModelFSMSubcontract`; `state_machine_version` carries only keys typed models declare.
- **#3469**: Provider availability reported separately from correctness; cohort tiers validated on lab (23/23 golden chain tests pass).

### Codegen & Events
- **#3821**: `node_hybrid_codegen_orchestrator` returns bare typed event models per phase; `node_codegen_outcome_reducer` adds `published_events` mapping outcomes to topics (without it, runtime treats bare model return as unpublished projection).

### BYOK & Providers
- **#3194**: OpenAI BYOK backend (`byok-openai`, `api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions`); model preference: newest `gpt-4.N-nano` → `gpt-4.N-mini` → `gpt-4o-mini`; `gpt-5`/o-series excluded (reject `max_tokens`).

### CI & Workflows
- **#142**: `omni-standards-compliance.yml` with blocking ruff UP007/UP006; mypy already enforced; fixed pre-existing violations and stale anchors.
- **#1901**: Receipt-gate shadow input allows repos refusing non-success check-runs to carry S5 caller; avoids CI Summary failure on skipped/failed external jobs.
- **#1705**: Secrets-baseline census gate as CI job (not new workflow) in consolidated workflow; gated by quality-gate tier-1 where only `success` passes (skipped/cancelled/unrecognised fail).
- **#1629**: Fixed md-only short-circuit zone classifier `PackageNotFoundError` by staging classifier without `uv sync`.
- **#3731**: Hostile Reviewer reads voters from `omnibase_infra` docker overlay at runtime; ratchet refuses voter config in workflow.
- **#3132**: Receipt runner waits for quiet batch window before push; applies companion emitter's in-flight test.
- **#3400**: `parity --utc-day --receipt` prints daily work-ledger parity receipt row; `--explain` classifies missing rows.
- **#180**: `softprops/action-gh-release` bumped 2→3 (semver-major).
- **#132**: `actions/checkout` bumped 4→6 (semver-major).

### Testing & Quality
- **#1719**: Documented root-anchored merge-sweep pattern; `gitignore-baseline.yaml` schema_version 1.1.0→1.2.0 with rationale.
- **#1585**: `ModelContractBase` declares `event_bus`, `mcp`, `intent_consumption`; `ModelEventBusSubcontract` gains `dlq_topics`; removed `NodeCompute`'s dead `getattr(contract, 'metadata')` read.
- **#3807**: Decisions exposure serves stored `cost_usd` in both local-store and terminal write paths; non-round costs verified; zero-cost rows excluded from sums.
- **#1487**: Closed two residual `sys.modules` contaminators in `test_model_fast_imports.py` and `test_model_lazy_imports.py` using `isolated_sys_modules` restore.
- **#3463**: Added npm runner (`npm test -- --run`, `npm ci`) and bare `uv --no-project pytest` runner; `declared_runner` takes `(repo, first_path)`.
- **#3619**: Added `node_hook_refusal_row_compute` (contract, metadata, Definition-B handler, two frozen models, `onex.nodes` entry); decides redacted, deduplicated FRICTION ledger row per hook refusal.
